## Module overview

We take a close look at the methods used in the study so we can interpret the figures that follow. Understanding how each experiment works is essential before analyzing the data.

## Learning objectives

By the end of this module, you should be able to:

- Describe the key experimental approaches used in the study.
- Identify the controls, variables and readouts of each method.
- Explain why each method was chosen to address the research question.

//| echo: false
checklist("module-3-todo", ["Review the Delftia background and the article's methods", "Complete the in-class activity and submit individually", "Create a representation of the methods (e.g. flow chart or sketch)"])

## Key themes in the methods

From the abstract, the study (1) isolates TC1 from mosquitoes, (2) tests inhibition of early *Plasmodium* development, (3) identifies a secreted small-molecule inhibitor, **harmane**, (4) tests whether TC1 colonizes the mosquito gut and affects fitness, and (5) uses contained field studies in Burkina Faso and modeling.

::: {.callout-important}
Always ask of each method: What is the **control**? What is the **readout**? What is the **variable**?
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
quiz("m3q1", "A control experiment is used to…", ["Prove the hypothesis is true", "Show the readout changes only because of the variable tested", "Replace statistics", "Increase sample size"], 1, "Controls isolate the effect of the variable.")
```
